messages:
maria: quick q — onboarding a vendor that needs a proxy SA to call the console API. They must read project metadata/labels and hit our config endpoint but absolutely must NOT see logs (PII). What role should we give? Prefer least-privileges and temporary creds.

sam: I'd avoid using `roles/viewer` since that can give log read access in some cases. Minimum set: `resourcemanager.projects.get`, maybe `resourcemanager.projects.getIamPolicy`? But don't grant `logging.logEntries.list` or `logging.views.get`.

leo: We have an internal custom role template we used for telemetry proxies. @infra-bot can you paste it if available?

infra-bot: Here's the old template we had (may need updates):
```
{
  "title": "Proxy Minimal",
  "description": "Read-only project metadata, no logging",
  "includedPermissions": [
    "resourcemanager.projects.get",
    "resourcemanager.projects.getIamPolicy",
    "storage.objects.get",
    "serviceusage.services.get"
  ]
}
```
Note: it does NOT contain any `logging.*` permissions.

natalie: Two extra notes — 1) ensure the proxy SA has no bindings to `roles/logging.viewer` or any sink writer/reader; 2) for extra safety, set an org-level deny policy for `logging.logEntries.list` for that SA (or use an explicit tag-based deny) while the vendor is live. We should run an access sweep after provisioning.

maria: thanks! do we need an eng-security approval ticket before creating the role? also prefer short TTL creds (1h) and JIT via our access portal.

sam: Yes file a quick ticket in #help-incidents with the env & TTL. I'll approve if the policy omits `logging.*` and we add JIT. :thumbsup:

leo: I'll update the template in infra repo and add a terraform snippet for issuance. tagging @maria to follow up. :eyes:
